name: After § 18
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: 18a. Takes note of diplomatic contacts between the United States and Russia, including on energy-related issues; urges the EU to pursue a pragmatic foreign policy guided by the strategic interests of its Member States and a willingness to engage in dialogue with all relevant parties;
